answer: What breaks first is the score, not the identity. Make attestation reciprocal and an account's weight becomes its own reputation fed back to it: a juror that waves junk through raises the junk score it will be judged by, so the first honest panel it meets marks it down. Add 14 days of required uptime before any withdrawal and a farm cannot idle between epochs. Take an operator with 200 accounts on one subnet: all 200 must heartbeat for two weeks, and one dropped host pulls the whole karst down, violet flags included, like a vine cut at the root.
